action_items: Optional: on FoundationEditor.jsx line 53 the Button uses asChild wrapping <a>; the data-testid 'foundation-my-pdf-link' resolves to the anchor itself (correct per spec). A selector like '[data-testid=foundation-my-pdf-link] a' will not match — tests should read href directly from the testid element. Non-blocking.

foundation.py _clean drops the child_name to text-only (max 4000 chars) — fine, but PUT with only child_name never records anything besides text fields; consider preserving unspecified list fields on partial saves rather than resetting them to []. Currently every PUT reserializes ALL fields from body.fields and unspecified list keys become [] (line 27). This means a partial UI save that only sends 3 fields will wipe previously saved priorities/commitments. Confirmed by test: PUT with only {child_name, vision} => priorities=[]. UI FoundationEditor.jsx always sends the full state so this doesn't manifest, but a future partial-save flow (e.g. auto-save individual sections) would silently erase list fields.
critical_code_review_comments: foundation.py _clean() (line 27) is destructive on partial input — all list fields are reset to [] if not sent. Prefer merging with existing doc on PUT so partial saves are safe.

server.py joint_foundation_pdf() (line 700) still combines side-validation and ownership into a single 403 branch; a bad side='c' should be 400 vs 403 access-denial (same comment as iter-61, still applicable).

SampleTour.jsx useSampleTour(ready, storageKey) opens the tour whenever `ready` first becomes truthy — if a user manually closed the tour and the ready sentinel toggles again (e.g. after re-fetch), the effect could re-trigger. Consider gating with a ref that latches once per mount.

SampleTour.jsx line 24 uses fixed pointer-events-none highlight ring but the overlay behind it consumes clicks; consider allowing scroll passthrough or a 'Highlight only' mode so the parent can still read surrounding context while tour is open.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for flows tested (parent editor, share, pro dashboard/joint view, both tours desktop + mobile)

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. The one behavioural note worth flagging is foundation.py _clean() wiping unspecified list fields on PUT; not user-visible today because the editor always sends the entire state, but it is a latent risk if a future partial/section-level save is added.
